page_title: OSA 1-0 VAL | Osasuna v Valencia 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' A cross into the box from Diego Lopez (Valencia) is cleared.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) has a goal ruled out for offside!

87' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Julen Agirrezabala pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
85' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
84' Substitution. Moi Gomez did his best and is replaced by Asier Osambela (Osasuna).
80' It's like he was asking for a caution. Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) receives a yellow card.
78' Lucas Torro goes off the pitch and Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) comes on.
78' Alessio Lisci has decided to substitute Aimar Oroz and he is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
78' Carlos Corberan has decided to make a change. Hugo Duro (Valencia) replaces Jose Copete.
78' Substitution. Pepelu leaves the pitch and is replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia).
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
74' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

71' Osasuna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
69' The attendance is 21226.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luis Rioja walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia).
67' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) replacing Javi Guerra.
65' The total number of attempts is 13:4.
62' The substitution has been made. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) has replaced Victor Munoz.
59' None of the Valencia players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
57' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Herrera, who smothers the ball.
54' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
53' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
51' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Osasuna win a corner.
49' Osasuna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) latches onto a short pass from Diego Lopez inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
43' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

43' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Valencia are going to take it.
41' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Valencia.
39' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
37' Ball possession – 54:46.
34' Valencia hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
31' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
28' Luis Rioja (Valencia) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Osasuna.
26' Substitution. Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) has come on for Dani Raba.
22' Jose Gaya (Valencia) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
22' Jose Gaya (Valencia) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jesus Manzano signals.
21' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.

21' Jose Gaya (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Valencia will take a corner.
19' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Julen Agirrezabala (Valencia) leaps to collect the ball.
19' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Julen Agirrezabala is alert and denies him with a nice save.
13' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle and it's Ante Budimir (Osasuna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
12' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
9' 1 - 0 Ante Budimir (Osasuna) leaped to meet a deep cross and nodded the ball past the helpless goalkeeper.
7' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
4' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

2' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Osasuna.

Valencia will kick the game off.
